operator.domain: Three real-valued event windows with exact rational or unbounded endpoints; endpoint inclusion retained.
operator.relation: donorOnset < contact <= recipientOnset; weak-donor equality is an explicit alternative parameter.
operator.projection: admissibleContact = K intersect (inf(D), sup(R)), with the recipient upper endpoint included exactly when R includes it; all input windows must be nonempty.
operator.proof: A feasible contact must exceed the donor infimum and not exceed an available recipient supremum. Conversely choose any point in that intersection, choose an earlier donor in D, and a recipient at or after it in R. Strict/open endpoints determine equality cases. The weak-donor case admits the donor lower endpoint only if D contains it.
operator.resourceBoundary: The endpoint input budget is computational only; it does not choose a historical time scale.

allTimeCounterexample.coordinates: Arbitrary real order coordinates, no historical dating.
allTimeCounterexample.proof: Both realizations use exactly the same two step functions. They are constant on each open cell and equal at both discontinuities, which partitions the entire real line. No query of these phonetic states can identify which causal realization generated them.
allTimeCounterexample.consequence: Sound-state agreement alone does not establish a transmission edge, even when the complete trajectories are known. Additional musical or relational constraints could discriminate only through a justified adapter.
allTimeCounterexample.scope: Existence of an observationally equivalent pair within these declared models; not a proof that all possible histories or every inheritance model are equivalent.

queryRegister.need: Context-matched independently licensed donor negative state plus recipient positive state, with their relative date bounds.
queryRegister.consequence: Can exclude the specified donor-to-recipient edge if the donor onset lower bound is later than the recipient acquisition upper bound.
queryRegister.missing: Both phonetic licenses, exact witness contexts and independently justified bounds; an absent transcription is not a negative phone observation.

queryRegister.need: Independently bounded period when this transmission could occur, plus recipient acquisition upper bound.
queryRegister.consequence: Can exclude this proposed contact if its earliest possible date follows recipient acquisition.
queryRegister.missing: Contact opportunity bounds cannot be inferred merely from failing to find a contact record; third-party and other episodes remain separate.

queryRegister.need: Independently justified transcription-to-phone mapping in the exact source context.
queryRegister.consequence: Can separate a pure written-normalization explanation from a changed-pronunciation explanation.
queryRegister.missing: Received vowel letters and current scholarly reconstructed phones are not independent ancient acoustic observations; hybrid explanations survive.

queryRegister.need: Evidence constraining transmission, copying or lineage independently of the sound-state trajectories.
queryRegister.consequence: Required to distinguish contact from an observationally identical independent-change realization when their full trajectories coincide.
queryRegister.missing: More sound-state samples, even perfect all-time phone trajectories in the counterexample, do not identify the causal edge.
